data: Did the filtering process reduce the number of examples with more than one emotion label?

No, the filtering process did not reduce the number of examples with more than one emotion label. The bar chart shows that the number of examples with more than one emotion label remained the same before and after filtering. The colors of the bars represent pre-filter and post-filter, the X-axis represents the number of labels, and the Y-axis represents the number of examples. The scale ranges from 0 to 40,000, and the height and position of the bars indicate the number of examples.
